title: Contents Packout & Storage Billing Adjustment Credits
content:
Adjustment credits on a Contents Packout & Storage job correct or relieve one charge line.

## Rule

1. The job must be in returned or invoiced status when an adjustment credit is posted.
2. A billing error credit equals the amount charged on the line less the amount the tier's rate and the recorded quantity produce, including a storage period billed to the wrong party or after the returned date, which is credited in full; a duplicate line credit equals the full amount of a line repeating another of the same code and date or period.
3. A billing error or duplicate line credit may be posted only when the customer raises the dispute no later than the dispute window after the final invoice was issued on this job.
4. The dispute window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the job's invoice date, and a dispute raised on the last day of the window is in time; on a job not yet invoiced the window has not started and the dispute is always in time.
5. Goodwill credits on one job may not exceed the tier's goodwill credit cap in total.
6. A goodwill request above the remaining cap is handed to a human representative as not covered by policy.
7. Each charge line takes at most one adjustment credit.

## Credit reasons

| Reason | Amount credited |
|---|---|
| billing error | the amount charged on the line less the amount the tier's rate and the recorded quantity produce |
| billing error, storage period billed to the wrong party or after the returned date | the full amount of that storage line |
| duplicate line | the full amount of a line repeating another of the same code and date or period |
| goodwill | within the tier's goodwill credit cap, counted in total across the job |

## The dispute window

The clock starts from the invoice date recorded on the job when the final invoice was issued. Day 1 is the day after that date; the window lasts the tier's dispute window days (the tier figure on the product's desk reference). On a job not yet invoiced the window has not started, and a dispute is always in time.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical 20-day window).** Final invoice dated the 1st of a 31-day month: day 1 is the 2nd and the last day is the 21st. A dispute raised on the 21st is in time; one raised on the 22nd is not.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- A line charged 12 units at 9.00 shows 117.00; 12 times 9.00 is 108.00, so the billing error credit is 9.00.
- With a hypothetical goodwill cap of 120.00 and 70.00 of goodwill already credited on the job, the remaining cap is 50.00; a goodwill request of 60.00 is above it and is handed to a human representative as not covered by policy.
